insights.headline: Gold steadies after Friday's rout, but a weaker rupee denies Indian buyers any relief
insights.summary: Gold and silver staged a tentative rebound on Monday after Friday's sharp sell-off, with MCX December gold futures near ₹1.38 lakh per 10 grams and spot gold back near $3,900 an ounce. But Bloomberg's India Edition flags a 'gold divide': global gold is down about 10% this year while MCX spot gold is up roughly 3%, because the rupee's slide has offset the global decline. Analysts told CNBC TV18 it is too early to call a reversal: prices must stop making lower daily lows and reclaim short-term moving averages.
points: MCX December gold futures traded near ₹1.38 lakh/10g on Monday; spot gold gained 0.6% to $3,899/oz and silver 1.3% to $49.76 after Friday's 3.7% slide.
Global gold is down ~10% in 2026 but MCX spot gold is up ~3% -- the rupee's weakness has erased the rout's benefit for Indian buyers, per Bloomberg.
Silver broke below the historic $50 level on Friday -- a major bearish signal; analysts say it must reclaim $55 before buyers return.
Fed-hike bets persist: markets price ~72% odds of a December 25bp increase after the 10-2 hold vote on Oct 28.
Dhanteras buying in focus: gold is ~20% off its peak and ₹1 lakh buys 25% more gold than in January, per NDTV Profit.

trending.title: Cautious bounce, not a bottom
trending.summary: Monday's recovery held into the MCX session, but analysts say lower daily lows must end and moving averages be reclaimed before any reversal can be called.

trending.title: Silver's $50 line breaks
trending.summary: Silver's plunge through the historic $50 level is the week's defining technical event; white metals keep lagging gold as industrial demand fades.

trending.title: The gold divide for Indian buyers
trending.summary: Global gold is down ~10% this year yet MCX spot is up ~3%: a weaker rupee means the rout isn't reaching Indian jewellers ahead of Dhanteras.

trending.title: Fed-hike overhang caps rallies
trending.summary: Roughly 72% December-hike pricing and hawkish Fed voices keep a lid on rebounds; the Nov 3 US vote and Friday's jobs data are the next tests.

trending.title: Dhanteras bargain hunt
trending.summary: With gold ~20% off its peak, retailers lean on cashback, making-charge cuts and digital-gold extras to pull festive buyers in before Nov 6.

items.title: Gold, silver outlook: Why analysts remain cautious despite Monday's recovery
items.summary: Gold and silver staged a tentative rebound on MCX on Monday after Friday's 3.7% rout, with December gold futures near ₹1.38 lakh per 10 grams and spot gold up 0.6% to about $3,899 an ounce; silver rose 1.3% to $49.76. Analysts at Lemonn and Bonanza told CNBC TV18 it is too early to call a bottom — prices must stop printing lower daily lows and reclaim short-term moving averages first.

items.title: Gold's Global Rout Isn't Giving Indian Buyers Much Relief
items.summary: Global gold is down roughly 10% this year, but Indian buyers are seeing no relief: MCX spot gold is actually up about 3% in 2026, Bloomberg's India Edition notes. The culprit is the rupee's slide against the dollar, which has offset the global price decline for domestic buyers -- a 'gold divide' leaving Indians waiting for the rout to reach their jewellers.

items.title: Gold rises on softer oil; markets parse Fed signals
items.summary: Gold rose 0.7-0.9% to about $3,901-3,908 an ounce on Monday, bouncing off Friday's one-year low below $4,000 as weaker oil prices cooled inflation fears, Reuters reported. Spot silver climbed 1.8-2.2% back above $50. Three Fed officials argued for more hikes; traders see ~73% odds of a December increase, with the US midterms and Friday's jobs report up next.

items.title: Gold and Silver Rebound Ahead of Diwali; Silver Jumps Rs 3,500
items.summary: MCX December gold opened Rs 518 higher at Rs 1,39,003/10g and hit an intraday high of Rs 1,39,179, while December silver opened Rs 1,962 up at Rs 1,81,094 and reached Rs 1,82,701 - a Rs 3,569 rise - ahead of Dhanteras. Comex gold traded ~0.33% higher near $3,911.60, silver up 2.24% at $50.38; Choice Broking's Kaveri More cited a near-3% crude fall and festive demand.

items.title: Gold futures rise to Rs 1.38 lakh on strong spot demand
items.summary: Gold futures firmed on Monday as fresh speculative positions and firm spot demand lifted prices, analysts said — the December contract on MCX gained Rs 281 to Rs 1,38,766 per 10 grams, up about 0.2%, while gold futures in New York rose 0.83% to $3,906.81 an ounce. The advance came despite broader global pressure on gold earlier in the week.

items.title: MCX gold rises Rs 600/10 grams, silver jumps Rs 3,000/kg ahead of Diwali as rate-hike bets linger
items.summary: MCX gold futures rose Rs 613 to Rs 1,39,098 per 10 grams on Monday while December silver futures gained Rs 2,800 to Rs 1,81,925 per kg, opening higher as Diwali buying set in. The rebound may stay capped: persistent inflation worries and calls by three US Federal Reserve officials for further rate hikes keep December-hike bets alive after the Fed left rates unchanged at its last meeting.

items.title: Gold falls Rs 2,282/10 gm to Rs 1.38 lakh; silver down Rs 1,264 to Rs 1.80 lakh/kg
items.summary: Gold and silver fell ahead of Diwali on a stronger dollar, profit-booking at high prices and buyers holding back; silver also faced weak industrial demand and futures selling. IBJA rates eased: gold down Rs 2,282 to Rs 1.38 lakh/10g, silver down Rs 1,264 to Rs 1.80 lakh/kg — about Rs 2.06 lakh below its all-time high. Expert Ajay Kedia advises buying in instalments.

items.title: Gold is 20% off its peak this Dhanteras, but jewellery stocks know something buyers don't
items.summary: Gold sits about 20% below its January record ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, yet remains roughly 8% costlier than last year's Dhanteras, while most listed jewellers are still in the green for the year. Jewellers earn on sale value, not weight: Titan and Kalyan posted strong quarterly updates on studded jewellery and lighter designs. Spot gold fell about 4% on Friday to near $3,875 an ounce.

items.title: SGB 2021-22 Series VII investors set for 200%+ gains as RBI fixes premature redemption at Rs 14,167
items.summary: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at Rs 14,167 per unit, with the early-exit window due on November 2, 2026 — five years after the tranche was issued at Rs 4,765 per gram (Rs 4,715 for online buyers). Investors redeeming now lock in an absolute capital gain of about 200.5%, over and above the 2.5% annual interest the bonds paid.

items.title: Gold's slide to one-year low: margin calls amplified a fall driven by Fed hike bets
items.summary: Gold's drop below $3,900 on Friday — more than 3% to a one-year low — was amplified by forced selling as a tech rout triggered margin calls, Commerzbank noted. Oil-fed inflation and ~70-75% odds of a December Fed hike remain the bigger drag; the bank expects metals to recover once leverage clears, with US jobs on Nov 6 and inflation on Nov 10 the next tests.

items.title: Silver Forecast 02/11: Historic $50 Support Breaks (Video)
items.summary: Silver's break below the historic $50 level on Friday is a major bearish signal, analyst Christopher Lewis said in his November 2 video outlook, noting the area has acted as key support for decades. He would not chase the decline after such a one-sided drop and said silver must reclaim $55 before he would consider buying, with higher real rates continuing to weigh.

items.title: Why the Gold and Silver Correction May Be a Historic Opportunity
items.summary: Investing.com's Patrick MontesDeOca calls gold's ~7.2% monthly slide — despite Iran tensions, crude above $110 and inflation worries — a historic buying opportunity, blaming forced liquidation and rotation into AI/crypto. Supports: central-bank accumulation, diversification demand. Slide drivers: Fed-rate expectations and institutional flows, including Tether's gold sales tied to bitcoin.

items.title: Gold, silver may extend losses as US vote, jobs data test sentiment
items.summary: Analysts told Business Standard that gold and silver may extend losses this week as investors track the US midterm vote on November 3, US jobs data, and geopolitical tensions for cues on bullion prices. MCX December gold fell Rs 3,539 (2.5%) in the week to Rs 1.38 lakh per 10 grams, while silver dropped Rs 16,587 (8.5%) to Rs 1.79 lakh per kg, JM Financial and LKP Securities analysts said.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026 offers: Cashback on digital gold, discounts on jewellery making charges and more
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras (Nov 6), PhonePe offers 2% cashback up to Rs 2,000 on 24K digital gold buys of Rs 10,000+ (till Nov 8); BharatPe adds 5% extra digital gold above Rs 100 plus leaderboard prizes; Joyalukkas cuts making charges 50% till Nov 8; Senco's Dhanteras Shagun gives up to Rs 14,000/10g off gold jewellery and 36% off diamond value, with zero old-gold exchange deduction.

items.title: Muthoot Finance rebounds, up 9% from 52-week low as stock reacts to Q2 nos
items.summary: Shares of gold-loan major Muthoot Finance traded about 9% above their 52-week low, reacting to the company's second-quarter results. The rebound comes amid a sharp fall in gold prices that has kept the spotlight on lenders whose collateral values are tied to bullion.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: Tech Sell-Off Raises Risk of a Drop to $45
items.summary: FXEmpire's technical analysis says silver is testing $48–$50 support after a tech-led selloff dragged it below key levels. A confirmed break under $45 could open a move toward $35–$37, while a close back above $60 would strengthen a bottom; heavy AI spending may attract buyers at lower prices.

items.title: Crash! Gold price suffers worst October in years: Did silver and platinum suffer too? Check monthly performance
items.summary: Mint's monthly review: gold logged its worst October in years, sinking to a one-year low near $3,876 an ounce, while silver and platinum suffered too — silver slipped below $50 for the first time in nearly a year and platinum hit a 13-month low. The piece traces the selloff to hot US inflation data, Fed rate-hike bets and a broader market rout.

items.title: Gold And Silver Prices See A Big Drop In October: Is Dhanteras The Right Time To Buy?
items.summary: News18's Business Desk recaps October's sharp MCX correction — gold futures fell nearly Rs 7,800 per 10 grams over the month while silver lost around Rs 44,840 per kg — framing the slide as pre-festive relief for buyers and asking whether the Dhanteras window makes this the right time to step in.

items.title: Silver Price Crash: 1 Kg Silver May Soon Equal 10 Grams of Gold as Gold-Silver Ratio Hits 79
items.summary: The gold-silver ratio has climbed to 79 from below 50 in January as silver's crash outpaced gold's. MCX silver is down about 57% from its Rs 4,20,048/kg peak to Rs 1,78,900; gold is down about 23% to Rs 1,38,419/10g. At these levels silver needs to fall another 22.6% — gold flat — for 1 kg to equal 10 grams of gold. Metals Focus sees silver supply easing into a 2027 surplus.

items.title: Gold, silver lose sheen
items.summary: Gold and silver closed October with a second straight monthly loss, per The Hindu BusinessLine's technical review: Comex gold fell 7.26% to $3,884.9/oz and silver 19.1% to $49.13; MCX gold slid 7.16% to Rs 1,38,419/10g and silver 20% to Rs 1,78,900/kg. Drivers: higher crude, sticky inflation, December Fed hike bets. Column flags Comex gold risk at $3,650-$3,750 and silver at $42-$43.

items.title: How did gold and silver perform in India ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali?
items.summary: IBJA data shows gold closed the week over Rs 2,200 per 10 grams cheaper after a swing of more than Rs 2,600, while silver closed over Rs 9,100 per kg lower with a Rs 13,135 per kg weekly swing — capping a volatile week for Indian buyers just days before Dhanteras and Diwali.

NDTV Profit calculates that Rs 1 lakh buys about 7.1 grams of 24-carat gold this Dhanteras — roughly 25% more than the ~5.7 grams it fetched at January's Rs 1,75,340 peak — with IBJA gold at Rs 1,40,054 per 10 grams on October 30. Gold is still ~8% costlier than last Dhanteras, and analysts favor staggered buying into the November 6 festival.
items.title: Your Rs 1 Lakh Buys 25% More Gold This Dhanteras Than In January. Should You Invest?
Dhanteras 2026: How To Check Gold Purity, Hallmarking And Making Charges
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, Outlook Money walks buyers through checking gold purity via karat and fineness marks, verifying the three BIS hallmark signs including the six-digit HUID code, and scrutinising the bill for making charges, net weight and GST before paying.

items.title: New research reveals how gold reacts to market panic
items.summary: BullionVault's analysis of sterling gold around 16 market-fear events — from 2018's Volmageddon to the Covid crash — found gold protected investors most of the time, averaging +0.5% after one trading day and +2% after 60 days, IFA Magazine reported. Returns averaged positive across every horizon studied, though US-dollar gold outperformed sterling gold at longer horizons.
